grids.name: harvested-p300c

verdicts.aggregate_purity: SURVIVES (66% of the cosine headroom survives the squash)
verdicts.neighbourhood_sampling: SUPPORTED (a cell is 86% as register-coherent as a cosine neighbourhood, and 6 neighbouring cells still return 4.22 distinct sources — 90% of the way from one register to chance)
verdicts.direction_means_register: REFUTED (adjacency carries 15% of the cosine headroom; even the label-cheating continent layout reaches only 35%, so the limit is the 2-D squash, not the annealer)
